thread:
terry: heads up: noticed node SDK retries on 401 but doesn't attempt a token refresh when we return x-redwood-refresh-available header from the platform. SPA browser SDK does a silent redirect refresh flow, so parity is broken.

rachel: hmm that's bad. what's the current behavior in node? just bubble 401 and retry once?

terry: exact: it retries once with exponential backoff then fails. platform sets header when a refresh token exists server-side, but node SDK has no hook to call refresh endpoint.

leo: we should add an optional `auth.refreshHandler` in SDKs: if present, call it on first 401 and then retry the request with new token. for browser, keep silent redirect/iframe flow behind flag.

ana: can we avoid magic? prefer explicit: SDK exposes `setRefreshHandler(fn)` and `onAuthFail` callback. sample app demonstrates exchange flow: short-lived access token + refresh token on cookie.

terry: agree on explicit. propose default behaviour: node/python/go = no auto-refresh by default (dangerous for servers), browser SDK = opt-in silent refresh. but add an opt-in `autoRefresh: true` for server SDKs for convenience in sample apps.

leo: also consider idempotency: if the failed request mutated state, retrying automatically is risky. we should only auto-retry safe methods (GET, idempotent PATCH) unless caller marks operation as retryable.

rachel: good catch. put that in SDK docs and surface an error subclass `AuthExpiredError` with `canRetry` flag.

ana: sample app tasks: 1) server-rendered web app using cookie refresh flow; 2) SPA sample showing silent refresh + fallback to interactive login; 3) CI example showing how to rotate service tokens without interrupting builds. I'll PR those.

ops: ops notes: when rotating tokens in k8s, we recommend mounting a secret and using a sidecar that watches and execs a `SIGHUP`-style refresh rather than killing pods. also add `/health?auth=leaf` endpoint to check token validity without impacting main traffic.

terry: GH Actions snippet I used for testing refresh flow:
```yaml
env:
  REDWOOD_SERVICE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.ROTATABLE_TOKEN }} # used for background workers
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: run tests
        run: yarn test
        env:
          REDWOOD_REFRESH_ENDPOINT: https://auth.redwood.test/refresh
```
this fails to simulate refresh when token rotated mid-run.

leo: recommended CI pattern: use short job-specific tokens injected per-run (via workflow dispatch or ephemeral secret broker) or implement token refresh logic in test harness. add docs for `rw token create --one-time` to generate ephemeral token for GH Actions.

rachel: instrumentation: emit metric `redwood.auth.token_expiry_seconds` and a counter `redwood.auth.refresh_attempts{result}` so infra can alert before mass expiry. also SDK should log a one-time warning when token TTL < 5min.

ops: agree. we'll wire alerts. for clusters, include a migration guide: rotate secret, then trigger a rolling restart with `kubectl rollout restart` if sidecar approach not used.

dev-tools-bot: Please open an RFC or bug for: "SDK token refresh hooks + auth retry policy" with repro, proposed API, and test matrix (node/python/go/browser).

terry: filed issue DEVX-8433 and linked minimal repro + curl sequence that returns header `x-redwood-refresh-available: true`. putting API sketch in docs/sdk/auth-refresh.md (WIP).

rachel: i'll add the AuthExpiredError class and `setRefreshHandler` to the node client. leo, can you add tests for fetch retry semantics?

leo: on it. will add e2e with sample apps to ensure no silent double-posts.

ana: will push sample app PRs and GH Actions examples today. also adding explicit note in onboarding guide about not using long-lived org tokens for local dev.

ops: we'll add k8s secret naming guidance: prefer `redwood.service-token` and `redwood.refresh-token` keys in the secret to avoid ambiguity.

terry: thanks all. feels good to get parity and safer defaults. closing when node + docs + samples merged. :white_check_mark:
